chunks: From him, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Hāshim, from Ibn Miskān, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"The ʿatamah is until one-third of the night, or until half of the night, and that is neglect."

key_terms.التَّضْيِيعُ: neglect or wasting, meaning blameworthy delay
key_terms.اللَّيْلِ: the night, used here for calculating prayer time
key_terms.الْعَتَمَةُ: the night prayer, referring here to the ʿIsha prayer
key_terms.ثُلُثِ: one-third, indicating a portion of the night
key_terms.نِصْفِ: half, indicating the midpoint of the night

ai.seo_question: Is delaying the ʿIsha prayer until one-third or half of the night considered neglect?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the timing of the night prayer referred to here as al-ʿatamah, indicating that delaying it until one-third or half of the night constitutes neglect. It reflects a legal and devotional concern for performing salat within its proper and preferable time.
